title: Architecture Boundaries
description: A repository's explicit architectural boundary declaration (Standard 51 R2, ADR 0018), kept in its own file so that it can be a reviewed path of an attestation without being the file that records the attestation. Absent file means nothing is declared and no verdict, score or exit code changes. Shape is validated here; overlap, unknown members and cyclic edges are checked by scripts/boundaries.mjs; ownership of every in-scope file and the import directions are checked against the tree by `node scripts/boundaries-check.mjs`.

boundaryPath.description: A repository-relative path using forward slashes: a file, or a directory ending in `/`. No `..`, no leading `/`, no backslash, no drive letter, no glob.

boundaryEvidence.description: `path:line` citing where the repository states or exhibits the boundary or edge.

boundaryObservation.description: The observation limits of the check, stated by the declaration itself. A claim about this repository's boundaries holds only within these limits.

method.description: How edges are observed. Only static import graphs are defined.

cannotObserve.description: Mechanisms the method cannot see. Unobserved dynamic import, reflection, generated code, subprocesses, network and data-access paths are excluded from any claim unless a detector named here covers them.

knownSites.description: Files known to use the mechanism. When the mechanism is `subprocess` the checker requires this to equal the set of in-scope files importing node:child_process, so a new site must be declared. That detects the import, never what is executed.

processExit.description: `permitted` lets files of this member call process.exit or set process.exitCode. Absent means they may not. A string rather than a boolean because the policy parser reads scalars as strings and refuses to guess types.

boundaryEdge.description: A permitted direction: files of `from` may import from files of `to`, and only the named exports in `via`. Imports within one member are always permitted. Anything else crossing members is a boundary bypass.

via.description: The permitted interface: export names, or ["*"] to permit any, stated explicitly rather than by omission.

boundaryExternal.description: Specifiers that leave the repository. A bare specifier whose prefix is not listed is an undeclared external dependency.
